answer.text: For iOS, the manual says the minimum supported iOS version will be one version behind the current iOS release.
For Android, the manual says the app's minimum supported version will be two versions behind the current Android OS.
The manual also states that Huawei phones are not compatible with the app and are not supported.

disclaimers.text: The manual does not say whether the RE Mobile app works with any specific new or just-released phone OS version, so it cannot confirm that your new OS will work.
The statements above describe minimum supported versions only, not whether a brand-new release is supported or tested.
